subject.title: feat(gateway): thread authenticated user identity into presence

question: Should this first identity slice publish only an opaque authenticated-user ID in presence and audit logs, deferring `email`, `name`, and `avatarUrl` until a gateway identity contract guarantees those claims?
rationale: The PR creates a public gateway presence contract that follow-up profile and UI work will depend on; source evidence shows current auth results do not guarantee an email-shaped identity.

options.title: Publish opaque IDs only
options.body: Keep `user: { id }` in this slice, clear it on userless updates, and add richer claims only when their provenance is defined.

options.title: Define an email-bearing auth contract first
options.body: Extend the authentication result to distinguish opaque subject IDs from verified email claims before exposing `user.email`.

recommendation.title: Publish opaque IDs only
recommendation.body: Keep `user: { id }` in this slice, clear it on userless updates, and add richer claims only when their provenance is defined.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed the linked identity program and recently carried the adjacent gateway-protocol compatibility work.
